subject: BrightWell Health — notarized IAM evidence and SSO/SCIM samples
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@brightwellhealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWell Security intake — notarized IAM evidence request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. As part of BrightWell's SIG/SOC2 intake for Redwood, our security and procurement teams need a few items we classify as "notarized evidence" for access controls and identity. Please confirm whether Redwood can provide the following by EOD Wednesday, Apr 30: 

- A signed/attested cover letter certifying the snapshot dates and that the attached samples are true copies of production artifacts (DocuSign is acceptable).
- A SAML assertion sample (with PII redacted) that matches an active user login within the last 30 days.
- SCIM delta export (role assignments and user-to-group mappings) covering the last 7 days.
- RBAC owner roster for the application-specific roles we referenced in the SIG (role name, owner email, last review date).
- Confirmation whether any of the exported artifacts include PHI or other regulated identifiers.

We attached our intake checklist for your team (BWH_Intake_SIG_Form.xlsx). Also, if you have standard language for the cover letter (attestation template) we can accept, please share. If DocuSign is fine, we'll sign on our side as well.

One more ask: if you can produce hashed identifiers for audit logs rather than raw usernames that would accelerate our privacy review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we're aligning procurement approval to that evidence.

Best,
Samira Patel
Director, Information Security
BrightWell Health

Attachment: BWH_Intake_SIG_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: samira.patel@brightwellhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWell Security intake — notarized IAM evidence request

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can meet this timeline; DocuSign attestation is acceptable. Plan: 

1) I'll prepare an attestation cover letter and route via DocuSign for signature today.
2) Marcus will pull a SAML assertion sample and a SCIM delta export; we'll redact usernames and provide hashed IDs per your request.
3) Laura will produce the RBAC owner roster and include last-review dates.

Couple quick clarifying questions to make sure we deliver exactly what you need:
- For the SAML assertion, do you need the full raw XML (with NameID redacted) or are you okay with a sanitized text export that includes assertion fields, timestamps, and signature verification headers?
- For the SCIM delta, is CSV acceptable or do you require a native JSON export? We can produce both if necessary.

Action items/timeline (tentative):
- Today (Apr 29): prepare cover letter draft; Marcus pulls artifacts and begins redaction.
- Tomorrow (Apr 30) by 5pm PT: final artifacts + DocuSign complete.

If anything changes on your end (longer legal review, notarization rules), let me know ASAP. CC'ing Marcus and Laura — Marcus, can you confirm the export formats you plan to use? Laura, I'll include the RBAC sheet you prepared yesterday.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@brightwellhealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@willowsec.com
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWell Security intake — notarized IAM evidence request

Jordan — DocuSign is fine. 

Answers:
- SAML: sanitized text export with the full set of assertion fields is fine; include the raw Signature element but you may redact certificate content.
- SCIM: CSV is acceptable; please include a mapping file that documents column meanings.

I've attached our SIG subset and checklist (BW-SIG-Checklist.pdf) to make sure we match expectations. We'll need the DocuSign cover letter and artifacts by EOD tomorrow to stay on the procurement timeline.

Also: we may request a short notarized statement from Redwood legal confirming the artifacts reflect production state as of the snapshot timestamp. DocuSign with a registered signing officer is typically sufficient for us — no physical notary required.

Thanks again — Willow Security (cc'd) will run the artifacts through a quick verification.

Regards,
Samira

Attachment: BW-SIG-Checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: samira.patel@brightwellhealth.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWell Security intake — notarized IAM evidence request

Samira — sending the deliverables and next steps below. Thanks for the guidance; we followed the sanitization and hashing guidance from your checklist.

Delivered artifacts (attached / linked):
- Redwood attestation cover letter (signed via DocuSign): BWH_ATT_Coverletter_20250430.pdf (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?r=12345)
- SAML assertion sample (sanitized text): redwood-saml-assertion-sample.txt (attached) — includes assertion fields, timestamps, and Signature element with cert fingerprint only; NameID replaced with hashed_id_XXXXX.
- SCIM delta export (CSV): redwood-scim-snapshot-20250428.csv (attached) — includes column mapping appendix in the first tab. Sensitive usernames replaced with sha256 hashed IDs; see appendix for salt policy.
- RBAC owner roster: RBAC_owner_roster_BWH_20250430.csv (shared in Drive) — columns: role_name, owner_email, owner_team, last_review_date.
- SIG checklist mapping: BWH_SIG_2025.pdf (attached) — we annotated which artifacts correspond to checklist items.

Links: shared Drive folder with redaction notes and raw export artifacts (access granted to your security and procurement group): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBWH-iam-evidence

Notes/assurances:
- We verified that no exported artifact contains PHI; where regulated identifiers were present they are replaced with salted sha256 hashes (salt stored in Redwood KMS and available to BrightWell under NDA request).
- The attestation is signed by Redwood's Head of Legal via DocuSign and states these are production snapshots taken on 2025-04-28 (SCIM) and 2025-04-29 (SAML sample).
- Marcus has confirmed logs were sampled and redacted per your checklist. Marcus — please reach out to Samira if you need to coordinate a short verification call.

If Willow Security needs any additional formats (JSON SCIM export or raw assertion XML under an NDA), we can provide them; please let us know specific recipients and the intended use.

Next steps:
- Samira: confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet the SIG intake.
- Willow Security: let us know if verification identifies gaps; we can schedule a 30-min troubleshooting call this week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
